say:1:1029790401:1.text: Ahh, the general's back! I can finally relax a little.
say:1:1029790401:1.source_cn: 哎呀，将军回来了，我总算能松口气了。
say:1:1029790401:1.male: Ahh, the general's back! I can finally relax a little.
say:1:1029790401:1.female: Ahh, the general's back! I can finally relax a little.

say:2:1029790402:1.text: I was so swamped earlier, I didn't even have time to sit down with you.
say:2:1029790402:1.source_cn: 之前忙得焦头烂额，都没时间和你闲聊了。
say:2:1029790402:1.male: I was so swamped earlier, I didn't even have time to sit down with you.
say:2:1029790402:1.female: I was so swamped earlier, I didn't even have time to sit down with you.

say:3:1029790403:1.text: I heard you had quite the journey this time. The general even got injured. How are you doing?
say:3:1029790403:1.source_cn: 我听说你们这次的经历颇为惊险，将军都负伤了，你怎么样？
say:3:1029790403:1.male: I heard you had quite the journey this time. The general even got injured. How are you doing?
say:3:1029790403:1.female: I heard you had quite the journey this time. The general even got injured. How are you doing?

choice_prompt:4:1029790403.text: I heard you had quite the journey this time. The general even got injured. How are you doing?
choice_prompt:4:1029790403.source_cn: 我听说你们这次的经历颇为惊险，将军都负伤了，你怎么样？
choice_prompt:4:1029790403.male: I heard you had quite the journey this time. The general even got injured. How are you doing?
choice_prompt:4:1029790403.female: I heard you had quite the journey this time. The general even got injured. How are you doing?

say:5:1029790404:1.text: Great to hear! From the way you're handling such a big event, I can tell you're doing fine.
say:5:1029790404:1.source_cn: 那真是太好了，虽说看你这么精神十足地办这么大的活动，就...
say:5:1029790404:1.male: Great to hear! From the way you're handling such a big event, I can tell you're doing fine.
say:5:1029790404:1.female: Great to hear! From the way you're handling such a big event, I can tell you're doing fine.

say:6:1029790405:1.text: But it's somehow more reassuring to hear it from you, though.
say:6:1029790405:1.source_cn: 但听你自己说还是会放心点。
say:6:1029790405:1.male: But it's somehow more reassuring to hear it from you, though.
say:6:1029790405:1.female: But it's somehow more reassuring to hear it from you, though.

say:7:1029790406:1.text: Now, let's leave the poor general to wrestle with all this work. I'm going to enjoy my time off.
say:7:1029790406:1.source_cn: 那么，接下来就让可怜的将军稍微忙活忙活吧，我可要到处玩玩了。
say:7:1029790406:1.male: Now, let's leave the poor general to wrestle with all this work. I'm going to enjoy my time off.
say:7:1029790406:1.female: Now, let's leave the poor general to wrestle with all this work. I'm going to enjoy my time off.

say:8:1029790407:1.text: You coming with me or staying here?
say:8:1029790407:1.source_cn: 你要陪我一起吗，还是留在这里？
say:8:1029790407:1.male: You coming with me or staying here?
say:8:1029790407:1.female: You coming with me or staying here?

say:9:1029790408:1.text: I've already told a few people that you're back.
say:9:1029790408:1.source_cn: 我已经把你回来的消息告诉不少人了。
say:9:1029790408:1.male: I've already told a few people that you're back.
say:9:1029790408:1.female: I've already told a few people that you're back.

say:10:1029790409:1.text: Your students and admirers might swing by soon too.
say:10:1029790409:1.source_cn: 说不定你的学生和崇拜者不久后也会过来呢。
say:10:1029790409:1.male: Your students and admirers might swing by soon too.
say:10:1029790409:1.female: Your students and admirers might swing by soon too.
